title: Compound Brightfield Microscope

references.label: General microbiology laboratory manuals (ASM curriculum resources)
Biosafety in Microbiological and Biomedical Laboratories (BMBL)

purpose: Magnifies specimens using visible light and a system of lenses, the core tool for observing stained and unstained microbiological preparations.
operatingPrinciple: Light from an illuminator passes through a condenser, the specimen, an objective lens, and an ocular lens, with total magnification equal to objective magnification × ocular magnification.
basicOperation: Start at the lowest-power objective and adjust coarse then fine focus.
Adjust the condenser/diaphragm for even illumination.
Progress to higher-power objectives, using only fine focus once roughly focused.
Use oil only with the objective specifically rated for immersion oil.
importantSettings: Condenser height and diaphragm aperture (controls light amount/contrast, and, to a lesser extent, resolution).
Interpupillary distance and diopter adjustment for binocular comfort/focus.
calibration: Routine classroom/teaching microscopes typically don't require formal calibration, but objective/ocular cleanliness and proper Köhler-style alignment materially affect image quality; a calibrated stage micrometer is used when precise size measurements are needed.
maintenance: Clean lenses only with lens paper and appropriate lens cleaner — never tissue or clothing, which can scratch coatings.
Remove immersion oil from the 100× objective immediately after use.
Cover the microscope when not in use to reduce dust.

commonErrors.cause: Condenser too low, diaphragm too closed, or insufficient illumination
commonErrors.fix: Raise the condenser and open the diaphragm appropriately for the objective in use

commonErrors.problem: Cannot achieve sharp focus at high power
commonErrors.cause: Attempting large coarse-focus adjustments at high magnification, or oil/dust on the lens
commonErrors.fix: Use only fine focus at high power; clean lenses with lens paper

safety: Handle the microscope by its arm and base to avoid dropping it.
Return to low power before storing to protect the objective and slide.
